description: Kotlinx Collections Immutable fixture aggregating 5 scenario groups and 20 deterministic calls against kotlinx.collections.immutable.
notes: Aggregates the previous persistent-collection Kotlinx fixtures into one library-level module so the Kotlin/Wasm runtime and kotlinx.collections.immutable implementation are embedded once while preserving list, map, set, builder, and nested-structure coverage.
